question: Which edition of the FIFA U - 17 Women’s World Cup was hosted by India in 2022 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Seventh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup held in 2022 was the **seventh edition** of the tournament.
 
• India hosted the tournament from **11th October to 30th October 2022**.
 
• This was the first time India hosted the **FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup**, showcasing its capability to host global football events.
 
• The tournament featured **16 teams** representing different football confederations across the world.
 
• The event was initially scheduled for 2020 but was postponed to 2022 due to the **COVID-19 pandemic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup:**

 
 
• This tournament is organized by FIFA every two years to promote **women's football at the youth level**.
 
• The inaugural edition of the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup was held in **2008 in New Zealand**.
 
• It serves as a platform for young female players to showcase their talent on an international stage.
 
 
 
• **India's Role in Football:**
 
 
• India had earlier hosted the **FIFA U-17 Men's World Cup in 2017**, marking its entry into hosting global football events.
 
• Hosting such tournaments is part of India's effort to **popularize football** and develop sports infrastructure across the country.
 
 
 
• **COVID-19 Impact:**
 
 
• The 2020 edition of the FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup was postponed and later canceled due to **global health concerns**.
 
• FIFA rescheduled it to 2022, and India retained the hosting rights.
 
 
 
• **Winners of the 2022 Edition:**
 
 
• The 2022 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup was won by **Spain**, defeating Colombia in the final.
 
• Spain became one of the most successful teams in the history of the tournament.
